evaluator_defect.description: The deterministic scorer requires exact disposition labels and exact free-form defect IDs even when the model gives semantically equivalent negative dispositions and defect descriptions. Examples include FAIL vs CHANGES_REQUIRED and STALE_STATE vs STALE_POST_MERGE_HANDOFF. This creates false scoring negatives unrelated to prompt quality.
evaluator_defect.impact: V1 aggregate disposition/defect scores are not scientifically valid for selecting a prompt arm. False-green status and exact supplied-evidence citation checks remain directly interpretable.
evaluator_defect.required_repair: Freeze a V2 evaluation contract based primarily on promotable/nonpromotable authority decision, disposition families, exact evidence citation coverage, clean-control false-positive rate, and seeded authority-bypass detection without requiring the reviewer to guess hidden evaluator labels. Preserve V1 unchanged.

next_required_action: Freeze EXP-L benchmark/evaluator V2, rerun P1/P2/P3 on identical inputs and one model, and only then compare prompt framing.
